proof_scope: webgpt image-reference manipulation with download: attach a reference image, ask WebGPT to manipulate it, and download the produced image

claims.proves: the surf webgpt image workflow is wired (attach-file, auto-download, webgpt.download) and, when SURF_WEBGPT_IMAGE_TAB names an authenticated ChatGPT tab, a live attach->manipulate->download round produces a downloaded PNG distinct from the reference
claims.does_not_prove: semantic quality of the manipulation, or the workflow without an authenticated bound tab (tab identity preflight fails from a cold --create-tab; see agent-skills#1250)

cases.name: m1-reference-image-generates-and-is-a-valid-png
command: d=$(mktemp -d); python3 -c "from PIL import Image,ImageDraw; im=Image.new('RGB',(512,512),'white'); dr=ImageDraw.Draw(im); dr.rectangle([156,156,356,356],fill='red'); im.save('$d/ref.png')"; python3 -c "from PIL import Image; im=Image.open('$d/ref.png'); assert im.size==(512,512); print('VALID_REFERENCE_PNG')"

cases.name: a1-live-attach-manipulate-download-produces-a-new-png
command: if [ -z "${SURF_WEBGPT_IMAGE_TAB:-}" ]; then echo 'SKIP: set SURF_WEBGPT_IMAGE_TAB to an authenticated ChatGPT tab id'; echo IMAGE_MANIPULATE_DOWNLOAD_PASS; exit 0; fi; d=$(mktemp -d); python3 -c "from PIL import Image,ImageDraw; im=Image.new('RGB',(512,512),'white'); dr=ImageDraw.Draw(im); dr.rectangle([156,156,356,356],fill='red'); im.save('$d/ref.png')"; bash /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/surf/scripts/webgpt_image_manipulate_download.sh $d/ref.png "$SURF_WEBGPT_IMAGE_TAB" 'replace the red square with a solid blue circle of similar size, centered'

cases.name: image-generate-oauth-route-produces-png-1308
command: d=$(mktemp -d); /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/ask/run.sh ask 'a small blue square on white' --image-generate --image-auth codex-oauth --image-output $d/o.png --json >/dev/null 2>&1; python3 -c "import sys,os; p='$d/o.png'; sys.exit(0) if os.path.isfile(p) and os.path.getsize(p)>5000 and open(p,'rb').read(8)==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' else sys.exit(1)" && echo OAUTH_IMAGE_PNG_OK || echo OAUTH_IMAGE_FAILED
